items.change: Changed backend TypeScript resolution to NodeNext and raised the Node.js minimum version to support loading NestJS 12's ESM packages from CommonJS.
items.required_rule: S: CommonJS apps load v12's ESM packages through require(esm), which needs Node 20.19+/22.12+; NodeNext resolution for the exports maps

items.change: Added a pnpm package extension declaring TypeScript 6 as a peer dependency of @nestjs/swagger.
items.responds_to: The NestJS Swagger CLI plugin importing the TypeScript compiler API without declaring TypeScript, causing it to resolve an incompatible hoisted compiler.
items.required_rule: D: the Swagger CLI plugin resolved an incompatible hoisted TypeScript after the v12/TS6 bump; build failed

items.change: Changed the OpenAPI contract test to assert nullability through the schema's type array instead of nullable: true.
items.responds_to: NestJS Swagger 12 generating OpenAPI 3.1 nullability as a type array.
items.required_rule: D: the contract test failed on @nestjs/swagger 12's OpenAPI 3.1 nullability output

items.change: Migrated the backend from CommonJS to native ESM: marked the package as module, emitted .js production entrypoints, added .js extensions to relative imports, adjusted ESM-compatible imports and runtime path handling, and updated the Nest build configuration.
items.responds_to: NestJS 12's ESM-only packages no longer being workable with the previous CommonJS backend setup.
items.required_rule: S: moving your own code to ESM is optional in v12; done after the CommonJS upgrade worked (#988 title: 'NestJS 12 (CommonJS)')

items.change: Moved application bootstrap code into bootstrap.ts and made main.ts start OpenTelemetry before dynamically importing the NestJS application.
items.responds_to: NestJS and Express loading HTTP modules during static import evaluation before OpenTelemetry can patch them.
items.required_rule: knock-on of the optional ESM move (static ESM imports load Nest before OpenTelemetry)
